text:
maya: quick sync — noticed a regression on q4b-int4 vs fp16 for long code prompts. more hallucinations and truncated functions. thinking we should consolidate the code sample bank, remove noisy near-duplicates, and refresh the golden anchors. who can take lead?

anil: on it. do you have failing examples?

maya: yeah — small failing sample below:
```python
def fetch_user(id):
    # fetch from service
    conn = db.connect()
    row = conn.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=%s' % id)
    user = parse(row)
    return user
```
model returns unrelated SQL and an extra `commit()` call. metric: pass@1 down ~12% on >1k token prompts.

lucy: is this from the legacy-snippets bucket? last merge put a bunch of scaffolded stubs in there.

kai: i can run a de-dup pass with fuzzyhash + tokenizer-normalized fingerprint. plan: 1) canonicalize whitespace + normalize identifiers 2) fingerprint/cluster 3) sample clusters for manual review. i'll spin up the job.

maya: great. also need labeler instructions updated — golden set should include full-function examples with expected outputs + negative cases (hallucination triggers).

olivia: labeling capacity check — we have ~60 labeler-hours this week. can split into 3 x 20h batches.

anil: for quant tests i'll run q4b-int4 and int8 on the curated set and produce per-seq-length diffs. CSV layout: prompt_id, seq_len, fp16_ok, int4_ok, int8_ok, note.

kai: pushed dedupe job config: `kubectl apply -f dedupe-job.yaml` — running under `curation/dedupe-run-17056`.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Job curation/dedupe-run-17056 started on cluster 'curie' (pod dedupe-0).

lucy: flag — many snippets are model-generated; we need a provenance tag so we don't leak eval data into training inputs.

maya: agreed. add provenance column `source: model-generated|scrape|internal` in metadata.

olivia: labeler plan: Batch A (20h) focus on longfn (>800 tokens), Batch B (20h) medium (300-800), Batch C quick sanity checks. i'll create tasks in Loom.

anil: timing — can we get dedupe results by EOD PST? i'll kick off the quant compare tomorrow morning.

kai: EOD PST is tight but doable. will post delta counts and a sample list.

maya: ok. once dedupe + labels done, do a smoke eval on canary model + quant variants and post a notebook.

lucy: :thumbsup: small note — include the sentinel prompts we used for hallucination detection last quarter.

anil: noted. will add `sentinel_001..005` to the holdout.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: dedupe job dedupe-0 completed (exit 0). results: s3://redwood-curation/1705678901/dedupe-output.csv

kai: uploaded clustering output, dedup rate ~18% (removed ~32k near-duplicates). sample: s3://redwood-curation/1705678901/examples/long-removals.jsonl

olivia: labelers started Batch A (2 labelers). will flag blockers if they show up.

maya: thanks. one last ask: create a small 'golden-lite' (<100 cases) for quick CI regression checks. someone volunteer?

lucy: i'll author golden-lite from longfn positives + sentinels. should have a draft tomorrow.

anil: i'll run the quant smoke against golden-lite after labels land.

maya: also capture token-length distribution in metadata for routing decisions (we might route >2k tokens to fp16).

kai: added `tok_hist` to dedupe output. will include p50/p90/p99 buckets.

olivia: labelers report 7 ambiguous expected-output cases, pinging maya for triage.

maya: on it — i'll clarify examples and update the label spec. thanks everyone.
